15"""GCU400 ``swapaxes`` (zero-copy view, host-bound). 

16 

17``swapaxes`` launches no kernel: the entire cost is host-side dispatch plus one 

18``torch.as_strided`` view construction (~1.8 us measured on GCU400). The common 

19implementation delegates to ``swapdims``, which is imported eagerly and 

20therefore resolves to the *common* variant; that path re-validates both dims 

21through a generic normalizer and always builds two python lists. 

22 

23This specialization: 

24 

25* serves already-normalized in-range dims straight from a branch that only 

26 touches ``shape``/``stride`` (2-D swaps use tuple unpacking, no list round 

27 trip, because 2-D transpose is by far the most common call); 

28* keeps the generic normalize/raise path for negative or out-of-range axes, 

29 including aten's ``[-nd, nd - 1]`` reporting for 0-d and 1-d operands; 

30* always returns a *fresh* view object, even when both axes are equal, because 

31 PyTorch's view semantics reject returning ``self``. 

32""" 

33 

34import torch 

35 

36_AS_STRIDED = torch.as_strided 

37 

38 

39def _swapaxes_generic(self: torch.Tensor, axis0: int, axis1: int) -> torch.Tensor: 

40 """Normalize negative/out-of-range axes exactly like ATen, then swap.""" 

41 ndim = len(self.shape) 

42 # A 0-d tensor accepts only 0 and -1 (both denote the sole virtual axis), 

43 # so the accepted range is clamped to [-1, 0] instead of the rank-based one. 

44 max_axis = ndim if ndim > 1 else 1 

45 raw0, raw1 = axis0, axis1 

46 if axis0 < 0: 

47 axis0 += max_axis 

48 if axis1 < 0: 

49 axis1 += max_axis 

50 if not (0 <= axis0 < max_axis): 

51 raise IndexError( 

52 f"Dimension out of range (expected to be in range of " 

53 f"[-{max_axis}, {max_axis - 1}], but got {raw0})" 

54 ) 

55 if not (0 <= axis1 < max_axis): 

56 raise IndexError( 

57 f"Dimension out of range (expected to be in range of " 

58 f"[-{max_axis}, {max_axis - 1}], but got {raw1})" 

59 ) 

60 

61 shape = list(self.shape) 

62 stride = list(self.stride()) 

63 if axis0 != axis1: 

64 shape[axis0], shape[axis1] = shape[axis1], shape[axis0] 

65 stride[axis0], stride[axis1] = stride[axis1], stride[axis0] 

66 return _AS_STRIDED(self, shape, stride) 

67 

68 

69def swapaxes(self: torch.Tensor, axis0: int, axis1: int) -> torch.Tensor: 

70 """Return a view of ``self`` with ``axis0`` and ``axis1`` exchanged.""" 

71 shape = self.shape 

72 ndim = len(shape) 

73 if 0 <= axis0 < ndim and 0 <= axis1 < ndim: 

74 stride = self.stride() 

75 if axis0 == axis1 or ndim < 2: 

76 # Same axis (including every 1-D call) keeps the layout but must 

77 # still produce a distinct view object. 

78 return _AS_STRIDED(self, shape, stride) 

79 if ndim == 2: 

80 return _AS_STRIDED(self, (shape[1], shape[0]), (stride[1], stride[0])) 

81 sizes = list(shape) 

82 strides = list(stride) 

83 sizes[axis0], sizes[axis1] = sizes[axis1], sizes[axis0] 

84 strides[axis0], strides[axis1] = strides[axis1], strides[axis0] 

85 return _AS_STRIDED(self, sizes, strides) 

86 return _swapaxes_generic(self, axis0, axis1)
